text: The Second Cambodia Growth and Resilience Development Policy Financing (DPF) is a $275 million policy-based credit initiative by the World Bank, aimed at supporting Cambodia's private sector competitiveness, fiscal resilience, and social protection for vulnerable households. It is part of a series designed to aid Cambodia's post-pandemic recovery, improve the investment environment, and enhance institutional capacities to manage economic and disaster-related shocks. The initiative emphasizes environmental regulation and disaster risk management, aligning with Cambodia's structural reform needs.
